messages:
Maya (Marketing): FYI we just got the incident writeup from Ops. Need to align customer comms across status page, email, and social. Proposing a short staged sequence — immediate status update + targeted email to affected customers, then a follow-up public note once we confirm restoration. Thoughts? :wave:

incidents-bot: [alert] Region eu-west-1 - degraded performance (HTTP 5xx spike). Incident created: INC-20260321-482.

Jordan (Ops): +1 on staged. Ops timeline below: investigating now -> mitigation in 20-30m -> partial restore possibly in 1-2h. We should avoid promising a hard ETA in public.

Maya (Marketing): Good call. Draft status lines I was thinking (short):
- "Investigating: We are aware of elevated errors in eu-west-1 and are working to restore service. Impacted customers may see increased 5xx errors and higher token latency."
- "Degraded: We've identified a degraded dependency and implemented a mitigation to reduce errors. Some customers may still experience interruptions."

Priya (Product): Add a sentence on customer impact scope: which endpoints/models are affected and whether embeddings or streaming are excluded. Ops, can you confirm affected surfaces?

Jordan (Ops): Affected: text-generation (hosted API), streaming responses for models x and y. Embeddings and Private Dedicated clusters not affected.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect — I'll revise: "Investigating: Elevated errors affecting text-generation and streaming in eu-west-1. Embeddings and Dedicated/Private deployments unaffected." Keep it succinct for status page.

Sam (Support): For the targeted email list — filter by customers with >= 1000 tokens/min in eu-west-1 traffic in last 24h. We'll include a bullet on workaround (retry with exponential backoff) and note we'll follow up when resolved. Tone: empathetic, factual, one-sentence action items.

Maya (Marketing): Draft email snippet: "We're investigating elevated errors for text-generation in eu-west-1. If you are seeing errors, please retry with backoff; our engineers are working on a fix. We'll send an update when service is restored." Short subject: "Redwood: Investigating service degradation in eu-west-1"

Priya (Product): Legal/compliance: don't mention root cause specifics until post-mortem. Avoid naming third-party dependencies in public copy. Ops, please feed us a sanitized root cause once post-mortem is cleared.

Jordan (Ops): Ack. We'll give a safe summary after RCA. For now, status page can say "mitigation in progress" when we flip states.

Maya (Marketing): Timing for social: hold on public tweet until either (a) incident declared resolved, or (b) we have a clear mitigation and ETA. For customers we email immediately. Also suggest a small banner on docs homepage linking to the status page.

Sam (Support): I'll queue up CSMs for Tier-1 accounts — short slack template: "We're aware of the issue in eu-west-1, we're coordinating with engineering, will update by EOD or sooner."

Maya (Marketing): OK next steps: 1) Jordan to post initial short status page update now using the Investigating copy (I'll paste final text), 2) Sam to send targeted email to affected customers, 3) Hold social until Ops says resolved/mitigated, 4) Post-incident blog + post-mortem => marketing will draft a customer-facing summary (no deep technical detail).

Jordan (Ops): Posting status update now. Copy used: "Investigating: Elevated errors affecting text-generation and streaming in eu-west-1. Embeddings and Dedicated/Private deployments unaffected. Engineers are working on a mitigation."

incidents-bot: [update] INC-20260321-482 status changed -> mitigation in progress.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks. I'll queue the email and the docs banner. Sam, I'll DM you the email list and the one-line CSM template. Priya, we'll sync after the RCA for the postmortem summary.

Sam (Support): Got it. DM me the list. Will send within 15m.

Priya (Product): Thanks everyone. After resolved, let's plan a 30m cross-functional debrief to capture timeline and customer impact for the postmortem.

Maya (Marketing): Agree — scheduling a 30m debrief for 45m from now. I'll create the calendar invite and include the draft public summary for review. :calendar:
